map.布林带以 N 周期移动平均为中轨、以 K 倍标准差为带宽；价格触及上/下轨分别视: The Bollinger band takes the N-period moving average as the middle band and K times the standard deviation as the width; touching the upper or lower band is seen as an overbought or oversold signal, and a narrowing width usually means falling volatility.
map.带宽（Bandwidth）衡量波动扩张/收缩。: The bandwidth measures volatility expansion and contraction.
map.用 20 日收盘价计算中轨（SMA）、上轨/下轨（±2σ），判断价格相对位置。: Use the 20-day closing prices to compute the middle band (SMA) and the upper/lower bands (±2σ), and judge where the price sits relative to them.
map.计算布林带中轨(SMA)、上轨、下轨、%B 及带宽(Bandwidth): Computes the Bollinger middle band (SMA), the upper and lower bands, %B and the bandwidth
map.识别超买（贴近上轨）/超卖（贴近下轨）。: Identifies overbought (near the upper band) and oversold (near the lower band).
